[[File:BristlemelonSWG.jpg|200px|thumb|Bristlemelon]]
'''Bristlemelon''' was an edible [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] grown on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] by [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]]. The spines of the fruit had to be burnt off before eating. It had an extremely sweet taste.<ref name="galaxies">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref> [[Cliegg Lars/Legends|Cliegg Lars]] gave one to [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]] when he was courting her, and they shared it for dinner.<ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>
